recognize_zh: 周邊血液中除了分葉核嗜中性球外，還出現兩顆較大的細胞，細胞質佈滿深紫色粗大顆粒、幾乎遮住細胞核，屬於帶粗顆粒的未成熟顆粒球（前骨髓細胞／骨髓細胞）；嗜中性球細胞質也偏泡沫狀、顆粒明顯。這種左移加上顆粒增多，符合使用 G-CSF 後的反應。
features: Two large cells with abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse purple granules partly obscuring the nucleus (immature granulocytes, promyelocyte/myelocyte stage)
Segmented and band neutrophils with increased cytoplasmic granulation
Some neutrophil cytoplasm appears pale and faintly vacuolated
Normocytic red cells without significant poikilocytosis
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows neutrophils with increased, coarse cytoplasmic granulation and early left shift. Two large cells with abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure nuclear detail are present, consistent with circulating promyelocytes/myelocytes. Red cells are normocytic without notable poikilocytosis, and platelets are adequate. No blasts or dysplastic features are evident in this field, although nuclear detail of the granular cells is limited. In the setting of recent growth factor therapy, findings are consistent with G-CSF effect.

ddx.vs: APL shows numerous abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei, Auer rods/faggot cells and coagulopathy, rather than a few granular precursors in a background of maturing neutrophils.
CML shows marked leukocytosis with a full myeloid spectrum, myelocyte bulge, basophilia and BCR-ABL1, whereas G-CSF effect is transient with a clear therapy history.
Infection also causes toxic granulation and left shift but usually with Döhle bodies and vacuoles; the distinction rests on clinical context and resolution after drug withdrawal.
